vulnerability_title: Flash loan inflatable staking balance allows stealing rewards

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: Staking lets users stake and withdraw at any time, and earned() pays balance times the change in reward per share since the user's last snapshot. A user who stakes just before allocateSeigniorage and withdraws right after gets a full share of that allocation.
patterns_found: no lock-up or same-block restriction between stake and withdraw
reward per share computed from the total staked supply at allocation time
issues: The permissionless entry point FavorTreasury.allocateSeigniorage is in another file; Staking.allocateSeigniorage itself is limited to the owner or treasuryOperator.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: flash-loan stake before reward allocation captures rewards
